question: EJDI is related to CHBG in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JOIN is related to HMGL. To which of the following is NSMR related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed is a uniform backward shift of -2 positions for every letter.

**EJDI to CHBG** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af644bd723aa3787fa6efc42b27cbf52c77b620e683c1bd019d6b3e9aa85f452.png] 

**JOIN to HMGL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fee68c45c0d73caa77636f434d2f800f6f4d12aacf9b299c6769fd7627fdee7f.png] 

Similarlly NSMR related to,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7d2f227a76eb165ed1b50a0f5df29d36773b33e18b070ed72072334eba5ff2d.png] 

 

The resulting word is **LQKP.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
